title: Merge Conflict
description: Merging feature/tuning into main left app.conf with unresolved conflict markers.
mission: Resolve the conflict, keep timeout=30 and feature=true, and complete the merge commit.
success: The merge is complete with both required settings.
solution: Edit app.conf and remove conflict markers

lesson.what_happened: Both branches edited the same lines and Git needed a human decision.
lesson.be_careful: Always inspect the final file and run tests before committing a resolution.

hints: Run git status and open app.conf.
